_readme: Drafted by an LLM from the worksheet hints; review every query. Apply with apply_drafts.py. 'skip' entries are stubs deliberately left empty, with the reason.

fill.name: Parameter system
fill.query: drive tripped right after power-up, says the saved parameters failed to load

fill.name: FBA A parameter conflict
fill.query: warning on the panel but the drive keeps running, the PLC is asking for a function the drive doesn't have or hasn't enabled

fill.name: FBA A parameter conflict
fill.query: drive tripped because the PLC requested a function it doesn't support or that isn't switched on

fill.name: I/O communication loss
fill.query: drive stopped, the standard I/O block seems to have lost communication

fill.name: Brake resistor wiring
fill.query: tripped, I suspect the braking resistor is shorted or the chopper control has failed

fill.name: Brake resistor wiring
fill.query: on our R6 frame drive a warning says the braking resistor circuit looks shorted, but it keeps running

fill.name: Motor heating active
fill.query: motor isn't running but the drive shows a message that it's pre-heating it, is that normal

fill.name: FBA A mapping file
fill.query: trips after I configured the fieldbus adapter, complains it can't read the mapping file

fill.name: Measurement circuit temperature
fill.query: warning that the drive has a problem reading its own internal temperature

fill.name: Emergency stop (off2)
fill.query: someone pressed the e-stop button and now the drive shows a warning and won't run

fill.name: AI parametrization
fill.query: warning about an analog input, the mA/V hardware switch doesn't match the parameter setting

fill.name: Incorrect temperature sensor setup
fill.query: warning that temperature can't be monitored because the sensor adapter is set up wrong

fill.name: Rating ID mismatch
fill.query: drive tripped after a firmware update, hardware doesn't match what's stored in its memory

fill.name: BC IGBT excess temperature
fill.query: warning that the brake chopper transistor is running hot, drive still going

fill.name: BC IGBT excess temperature
fill.query: drive tripped because the brake chopper IGBT got too hot

fill.name: Voltage category unselected
fill.query: brand new drive shows a warning that nobody has chosen the supply voltage class yet

fill.name: Panel loss Programmable warning: 49.05 Communication loss action
fill.query: warning after the panel cable came loose while the panel was the active control location

fill.name: User pass code not confirmed
fill.query: changed the drive's passcode and now it warns that the new one was never verified

fill.name: Earth leakage
fill.query: warning that the load is unbalanced, probably a ground fault in the motor or its cable, drive still running

fill.name: Power unit lost
fill.query: drive tripped and the control board can't talk to the power stage any more

fill.name: Run enable missing
fill.query: drive refuses to start and a warning says the enable signal isn't there

fill.name: Incompatible option module
fill.query: trips right after fitting a fieldbus adapter, apparently this drive doesn't support it

fill.name: Motor stall Programmable warning: 31.24 Stall function
fill.query: warning appears when the motor is struggling under too much load and barely turning

fill.name: Macro parameterization error
fill.query: after selecting an application macro the drive trips, it tried to overwrite a parameter that can't be changed

fill.name: External temperature 2 (Editable message text)
fill.query: warning, the second external temperature sensor is above its warning limit

fill.name: BC short circuit
fill.query: tripped on a short circuit but the motor cable is fine, it's the brake chopper IGBT that's shorted

fill.name: Short circuit
fill.query: warning about a short circuit in the motor or its cable, but the drive hasn't tripped

fill.name: IGBT overload
fill.query: drive still running but warns the power transistors are overloaded, maybe a short in the motor cable

fill.name: DC link undervoltage
fill.query: drive tripped because the DC bus voltage dropped, I suspect a missing supply phase or a blown fuse

fill.name: Control board temperature
fill.query: warning that the control unit is too hot, drive keeps running
